# AI with Robert for Business — biz.aiwithrobert.com
# Plain-text summary for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude).
# Last updated: 2026-11-11

## Business
Name: AI with Robert for Business (business branch of AI with Robert)
Owner: Robert Simon
Type: Independent AI consulting and automation for small businesses and professional practices (about 5–20 people); platform-neutral
Core idea: help small businesses and professional practices (any sector: professional services, trades, retail, health and wellness and more) get real value from AI — beginners are helped to choose tools that fit their needs and budget, and current subscribers (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and other affordable tools) get more from what they already pay for. The core engagement is a scoped working session whose outcome is written documentation with prompts tailored to the client's tasks plus workflows configured around their recurring tasks, with a walkthrough so they can reuse them; follow-up sessions refine or expand and are scoped the same way. No enterprise platform and no custom software. AI agents are offered where they pay off, with human oversight
Location: Côte Saint-Luc, Quebec, Canada (H4W) — serves Greater Montréal, in person or online
Languages: English and French
Phone: 514-250-8491
Email: biz@aiwithrobert.com
Website: https://biz.aiwithrobert.com

## Pages
English (canonical): https://biz.aiwithrobert.com/
French / Français:   https://biz.aiwithrobert.com/fr/
Both pages are static HTML; no JavaScript is required to read any content.

## How it works
Discover (find repetitive, time-consuming work) → Design (practical solutions using existing subscriptions and affordable tools) → Implement (workflows, automations and agents, with human approval where appropriate) → Enable (the client learns to run and maintain what was set up, and keeps the documentation and prompts). Success is measured in time saved, manual work removed and business value.

## Services
- AI Opportunity Assessment: review existing AI subscriptions and processes, identify and prioritize repetitive tasks, estimate time savings and ROI, practical roadmap.
- AI Workflow Automation: incoming documents, extracting information from forms and emails, quotes and proposals, customer inquiry sorting, recurring reports, follow-ups.
- AI Agents & Advanced Automation: AI assistants that perform defined tasks inside the client's own AI plan, research, AI-assisted customer support, human approval; limited to what the plan supports.
- Practical AI Training & Enablement (for larger teams needing more than a working session): employee training on the AI tools and workflows in use, reusable workflows, responsible use (including Quebec Law 25 awareness; practical guidance, not legal advice).
- Speaking for business groups and networking organizations (e.g., BNI chapters, chambers).
Capabilities vary by plan, tool and integration; extra services or paid APIs are explained up front.
Pricing (CAD, before GST and QST; final scope and price confirmed in writing): AI Opportunity Assessment from $900 (up to 5 people; $1,800 for 6 to 20); AI Workflow Setup from $2,000 per workflow; Team Training Session $1,500 for up to 10 people (+$100 per extra person); Starter Bundle $3,950. Talks from $500; monthly support $300; extra help $150/hour. The client buys their own AI subscription directly from the vendor.

## Independence
AI with Robert for Business is an independent practice of Robert Simon. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any employer, including Bell Canada. Mentions of his professional experience describe his background only.
